----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. CS Rathore For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mukesh Trivedi, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 17/11/2023
The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.61/2023 of Police Station Nathdwara, District Rajsamand for the offence punishable under Sections 406, 420 IPC.

He has preferred this bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
Counsel for the petitioner submits that the offences are triable by the Magistrate.
The accused-petitioner is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficient long time to be concluded.
Therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.

[2023:RJ-JD:39440] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-14605/2023] Learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application.
Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any Preetesh Singh @ Pinnu vs State Of Rajasthan (2023:Rj-Jd:39440) on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2477175/
1 opinion on the merits of the case, I deem it just and proper to grant bail to the accused petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, the bail application filed under Sec.439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is directed that petitioner Preetesh Singh @ Pinnu S/o Sh. Anil Kumar shall be released on bail in connection with FIR No.61/2023 of Police Station Nathdwara, District Rajsamand provided he executes a personal bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sound and solvent sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of learned trial court for his appearance before that court on each and every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till the completion of the trial.
(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 171-MS/-
